title: NeoOrigins Power
description: A power grants one mechanical effect to a player via the origins system. File path: data/<namespace>/origins/powers/<power>.json. The `type` field discriminates which fields are valid.

type.description: Fully-qualified power type ID. See docs/API.md for the full catalogue.

name.description: Display name. Plain string = translation key.

hidden.description: When true, this power is excluded from the origin info panel. Useful for purely-internal flag/glue powers (e.g. neoorigins:toggle, action_on_hit setters under a multiple).

required_mods.description: Array of mod ids that must ALL be loaded for this power to load at all. If any listed mod is absent, the power is skipped at datapack load — it never registers, syncs, or appears in the origin panel. Use for soft-compat powers that drive another mod (e.g. ["dragonsurvival"]).

entity_action.description: EntityAction run on the player as a side-effect when the configured event fires.

modifier.description: FloatModifier (or array) chained onto the event's value (e.g. exhaustion, regen).

block_condition.description: Block-position filter for block events (block_break, block_place, block_use). Ignored on other events.

hands.description: Hand filter for interaction events (block_use, entity_use, villager_interact): only fire for the listed hands. Array or single string of 'main_hand'/'off_hand'. Fails closed when the event carries no hand info; ignored elsewhere.

hand.description: Singular alias for `hands`, read only when `hands` is absent: a single 'main_hand'/'off_hand' string (an array is accepted here too). Matches Apoli's action_on_block_use shape.

item_condition.description: Item filter for item-carrying events (item_use, item_use_finish, block_use, entity_use, villager_interact): the hook only fires when the used stack matches this Apoli item condition (id / tag / nbt / enchantment, with and/or/not composition). On the interaction events the stack tested is the one in the interacting hand. Fails closed when set but the event carries no item; ignored on events that never carry one.

effect.description: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for this exact mob-effect id (e.g. 'spore:mycelium_ef'). Ignored on other events.

effect_tag.description: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for effects in this tag (e.g. '#minecraft:harmful'). Combine with 'effect' (OR-matched). Ignored on other events.

power.description: POWER_ACTIVATED filter: only fire when the activated power's id matches. Single id string or array of ids (e.g. 'neoorigins:ground_slam'). Omit to fire on ANY power activation. Ignored on other events.

immunity_ticks.description: EFFECT_APPLIED only: after a successful cleanse (action cancels the event), grant this many ticks of full immunity to the same effect id before re-rolling. 20 = 1s; default 0 (no grace).

cooldown_ticks.description: After entity_action fires, suppress further firings of this power for this many ticks (20 = 1s); default 0 = no cooldown. Only gates the action path — modifier chains are unaffected.

action.description: Effect on dealing damage: restore_health, restore_hunger, grant_effect, or target_effect.

amount.description: Half-hearts healed (restore_health) or food points fed (restore_hunger); default 2.0.

effect.description: Mob effect id applied to self (grant_effect) or the victim (target_effect).

duration.description: Effect duration in ticks for grant/target_effect (20 = 1s); default 100.

amplifier.description: Potion amplifier for grant_effect/target_effect (0 = level I); default 0.

min_damage.description: Minimum incoming damage required before the action triggers; default 0.0.

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 the action triggers per qualifying hit; default 1.0.

target_group.description: Optional entity-group filter (undead, arthropod, ...) restricting which victims trigger it.

target_type.description: Optional specific entity-type id filter for the victim.

damage_type.description: Optional damage-type id filter; the action only fires for matching sources.

bientity_action.description: Action run with the holder as actor and the victim as target when a qualifying hit lands, in addition to the flat `action`. Accepts one action object or an array of them. Apoli wrappers (actor_action / target_action / and / chance / invert / damage / nothing) keep their actor-target routing; a bare verb is treated as a target action against the victim. NOTE: supplying this (or entity_action) with no explicit `action` flips the flat action's default from restore_health to none, so the parsed action stands alone.

entity_action.description: Alias for `bientity_action`, read only when that key is absent — same shape and semantics. Prefer bientity_action in new packs; `entity_action` exists so packs written against the Apoli naming keep working.

action.description: What happens when the player is hurt: teleport (random blink, 16 blocks horizontally / 8 vertically), ignite_attacker, or effect_on_attacker. Default teleport, which is also the fallback for an unrecognised value.

chance.description: Probability the reaction fires, as 0..1; default 1.0 (always).

min_damage.description: Minimum incoming damage before the reaction fires; default 0 (any hit). Rolled after `chance`.

duration.description: ignite_attacker: burn duration in ticks (default 60). effect_on_attacker: effect duration in ticks (default 100). Ignored by teleport.

effect.description: effect_on_attacker only: the mob-effect id inflicted on whoever hit the player (e.g. 'minecraft:poison'). Ignored by the other actions.

amplifier.description: effect_on_attacker only: effect level minus one (0 = level I); default 0. Ignored by the other actions.

action.description: Reward for killing an entity: restore_health, restore_hunger, or grant_effect. Default restore_health, which is also the fallback for an unrecognised value.

amount.description: restore_health: health points healed (default 4 = two hearts). restore_hunger: food points restored, truncated to a whole number. Ignored by grant_effect.

effect.description: grant_effect only: the mob-effect id granted to the killer (e.g. 'minecraft:strength'). Ignored by the other actions.

duration.description: grant_effect only: effect duration in ticks (20 = 1s); default 200. Ignored by the other actions.

amplifier.description: grant_effect only: effect level minus one (0 = level I); default 0. Ignored by the other actions.

condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gating the action: entity_action runs each interval only while it passes; else_action runs while it does not (default always-true).

entity_action.description: EntityAction run on the player each interval while the condition passes (defaults to noop).

else_action.description: EntityAction run on the player each interval while the condition does NOT pass (defaults to noop).

toggleable.description: When true the power binds a keybind that flips its periodic action on/off; while off the interval action never runs (default false — condition_passive powers are passive unless opted in).

default_off.description: Toggleable powers only: when true the power STARTS disabled so the player must opt in via the keybind (default false).

enabled.description: Kill switch for this power: when false the power stays attached to the origin but does nothing (no effects, no flight, no periodic action). Absent or true = active. Primarily written by the power_overrides config so a server admin can disable one power of an origin without editing the origin, but a datapack may set it directly.

cooldown_icon.description: Optional HUD icon: an item id (e.g. 'minecraft:elytra') rendered as the item, or a datapack texture path ending in '.png' (resolved under assets/<namespace>/textures/) drawn 16x16. When set, this toggleable power joins the ability HUD cluster: full-bright while toggled on, dimmed while off. Empty (default) keeps it off the HUD.

always_show_icon.description: If true, this power's cooldown_icon stays on the ability HUD cluster even while the power is idle / off cooldown (default false: idle icons disappear). Only applies when cooldown_icon is set; players can force this for every power via the always_show_ability_icons client config.

cooldown_ticks.description: Cooldown between uses in ticks (20 = 1s); default 60. Ignored when cooldown_resource is set.

cooldown_resource.description: Optional variable/resource power id whose live value (in ticks) is used as the cooldown length on each activation, overriding cooldown_ticks; empty = fixed cooldown. Pair with a neoorigins:variable counter to make cooldowns scriptable.

hunger_cost.description: Food/exhaustion points consumed per successful activation; default 0.

resource_cost.description: Optional resource power id whose value is spent on activation; empty = no resource cost.

resource_cost_amount.description: Amount of the resource_cost resource consumed per activation; default 0.

fail_action.description: Optional EntityAction run when an activation attempt is blocked by `condition` — e.g. an execute_command tellraw telling the player why. Not fired on cooldown or hunger/resource-cost aborts. The blocked attempt never consumes the cooldown.

When set, the HUD swaps this power's cooldown bar for the icon with a clock-style radial sweep; empty (default) keeps the plain bar.

key.description: Optional hotkey this active power binds to. A plain number N pins it to named-hotkey pool slot 'Hotkey N' (1-64); several powers sharing the same N all fire from that one key. radius.description: Blocks around the holder within which mobs are pulled in (default 8).

speed.description: Movement-speed multiplier mobs path toward the holder at (default 1.0).

entity_types.description: Entity ids or #tags drawn in; empty (default) pulls only animals (the vanilla follows-food set).

entity_blacklist.description: Entity ids or #tags excluded from attraction even when entity_types (or the animal default) would select them.

attribute.description: Attribute id to modify, e.g. minecraft:generic.movement_speed or minecraft:block_interaction_range / entity_interaction_range for reach; required.

amount.description: Numeric value applied to the attribute under the chosen operation; required.

operation.description: How amount applies: add_value, add_multiplied_base, or add_multiplied_total.

condition.description: Optional gate: a named-condition string (in_water/on_land/in_lava) or a DSL condition object; active only while it passes.

equipment_condition.description: Optional gate matching a worn item by id/tag in a slot; active only while worn.

item.description: Exact item id the worn item must match (e.g. minecraft:elytra).

tag.description: Item tag the worn item must be in (e.g. minecraft:swords).

location_condition.description: Optional gate on dimension/biome/structure; active only while there.

dimension.description: Dimension the player must be in, e.g. minecraft:the_nether (combines with AND).

biome.description: Exact biome id to match, e.g. minecraft:desert (biome fields OR-combine).

biome_tag.description: Biome tag the current biome must be in, e.g. minecraft:is_forest (OR-combines with biome/biomes).

biomes.description: List of biome ids; matching any one satisfies the biome requirement (OR-combines with biome/biome_tag).

structure.description: Exact structure id the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village_plains (combines with AND).

structure_tag.description: Structure tag the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village (combines with AND).

allow_water_surface.description: When resolving a spawn, allow standing on the water surface (default false).

allow_ocean_floor.description: When resolving a spawn, allow the ocean floor under water (default false).

min_y.description: Minimum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

max_y.description: Maximum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

can_see_sky.description: Require open sky (true) or allow caves/underground (false). Default: true on overworld-like dimensions, false in ceiling dimensions like the Nether.

tool.description: Vanilla tool item id the empty hand emulates for tier/break speed; default stone_pickaxe.

species.description: Dragon Survival species id the holder becomes while this power is granted, e.g. dragonsurvival:cave_dragon. Reverts to human form when the power is revoked. Requires the Dragon Survival mod — pair with a top-level "required_mods": ["dragonsurvival"] so the power never loads without it.

stage.description: Dragon Survival growth stage to start at, e.g. dragonsurvival:newborn. Optional; defaults to dragonsurvival:newborn.

extra_applications.description: Additional bone-meal growth applications per use; default 1 (so one use grows the crop twice).

saturation_bonus.description: Saturation added to food this player crafts; default 0.5. Additive, not a multiplier.

bonus_levels.description: Enchanting power added to the enchanting table's level calculation, as if this many extra bookshelves were present; default 5. Additive, not a multiplier.

biome_tag.description: Biome tag the player must be standing in for the effect to apply (e.g. '#minecraft:is_forest').

effect.description: Mob-effect id applied while in the biome; default minecraft:regeneration. Reapplied every second for 15s, so it persists while the condition holds and fades shortly after leaving.

amplifier.description: Effect level minus one (0 = level I, 1 = level II); default 0.

restitution.description: Fraction of downward impact velocity reflected back up on landing; <1 damps so the player settles (default 0.8).

min_velocity.description: Minimum downward speed (blocks/tick) needed to trigger a bounce, so walking and small steps don't micro-bounce (default 0.3).

max_velocity.description: Cap on the upward launch speed (blocks/tick) so terminal-velocity falls don't fling the player absurdly high (default 1.6).

multiplier.description: Mining-speed multiplier; stacks multiplicatively with other instances; default 2.0.

block_tag.description: Restrict the multiplier to blocks in this block tag, or matching this block id; a leading # forces tag-only. Omit to speed up every block.

fluid.description: Fluid that suffocates the player, "water" or "lava"; default water.

drain_interval_ticks.description: Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; higher = slower drain (20 = 1s). Read second, after air_loss_per_second; default 20.

air_loss_per_second.description: Alias, highest priority: air points lost per SECOND while submerged (higher = faster drain). Converted internally to 20/value ticks between drains, clamped to at least 1 tick. When set it overrides drain_interval_ticks and drain_rate.

drain_rate.description: Legacy alias for drain_interval_ticks (ticks between drains, NOT units per second — the naming that caused the original confusion). Lowest priority: only read when neither air_loss_per_second nor drain_interval_ticks is set. Prefer drain_interval_ticks in new packs.

interval.description: Ticks between each fire application; <=0 disables (default 20).

burn_duration.description: Ticks of fire set on the player each application (20 = 1s; default 100).

threshold_percent.description: Fraction of max health at or below which the player catches fire, as 0..1; default 0.25 (a quarter heart bar).

fire_ticks.description: Burn duration in ticks reapplied each second while below the threshold (20 = 1s); default 60.

fire_ticks.description: Burn duration in ticks applied per second when ignite is true (20 = 1s); default 40.

include_rain.description: When true the damage also applies while exposed to rain, not just while in water; default true.

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 to fully cancel an incoming damage event (default 0.15).

items.description: List of item ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).

tags.description: List of item-tag ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).

tiers.description: Optional value bands inside this edible set. The first tier whose items/tags claim the stack wins; anything unmatched uses the power's own nutrition/saturation. Use this to make a nugget worth less than an ingot and a storage block worth more.

tags.description: Item-tag ids this band claims. Also makes them edible, so a tier can add tags the top-level lists never mention.

nutrition.description: Hunger points restored by an item in this band.

saturation.description: Saturation modifier for this band; omit to inherit the power's own saturation.

saturation.description: Saturation modifier applied on consumption (default 0.3). Vanilla computes the saturation gain as nutrition * modifier * 2, so scaling nutrition per tier already scales saturation with it.

always_edible.description: If true the item can be eaten even at full hunger (default true).

consume_sound.description: Optional sound-event id played on consumption; omit to use the default eat sound.

effects.description: Mob effect IDs (e.g. minecraft:poison) whose application to the player is cancelled. Empty list = no immunity (unless inverted).

inverted.description: When true, the list becomes an exception list: immune to every effect EXCEPT those listed. true with an empty list = immune to all effects.

activation.description: Aura mode (default passive). 'passive' pulses entity_action every interval while granted, no upkeep (add toggleable:true for a free on/off keybind). ('toggle' is accepted as an alias for active.)

toggleable.description: Passive mode only: when true the aura gains an on/off keybind (still free, no upkeep) and starts ON by default. Active auras are always toggleable and start OFF; this flag is ignored for them. Default false (plain always-on passive).

interval.description: Ticks between aura pulses — and, in active mode, between upkeep charges (min 1; default 20 = 1s).

condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gate: entity_action pulses each interval only while it passes; else_action runs while it does not (default always-true). In active mode upkeep is still charged while the aura is on, regardless of the condition.

entity_action.description: EntityAction tree pulsed on the player each interval — typically an origins:area_of_effect applying damage/effects to nearby entities. Inside an area_of_effect, spawn_particles/apply_effect/damage/heal/clear_effect now run on each AFFECTED entity, so you can paint custom particles (and remove a potion's default ones via apply_effect show_particles:false) on everyone the aura touches (defaults to noop).

else_action.description: EntityAction pulsed on the player each interval while the condition does NOT pass (defaults to noop).

hunger_cost.description: Active mode upkeep: food points drained each interval to keep the aura up; the aura auto-disables when the holder can't pay. Default 0 = a free on/off toggle. Ignored in passive mode.

resource_cost.description: Active mode upkeep: optional resource power id drained each interval; empty = no resource upkeep. Falls back to hunger_cost when resource bars are globally disabled. Ignored in passive mode.

resource_cost_amount.description: Active mode upkeep: amount of the resource_cost resource drained each interval; default 0.

default_off.description: Override the initial on/off state of a toggleable aura. By default an active aura starts OFF (opt-in) and a toggleable passive starts ON; set this to force either. Ignored for plain (non-toggleable) passive auras.

render_elytra.description: When true (default) a vanilla elytra is drawn on the player's back while fall-flying. Flight works either way: this is purely cosmetic. When false, the player glides with no visible wings.

texture_location.description: Optional custom texture id for the rendered elytra, e.g. mymod:textures/entity/my_wings.png. Only applies when render_elytra is true; the model is always the vanilla elytra (texture swap only). Omit to use the vanilla elytra texture.

exposure.description: Brightness 0-1 in darkness; client currently uses ~0.7 (default 0.7).

group.description: Entity-group id. Built-in: undead, arthropod, water, illager, piglin, skeleton. A bare name resolves to neoorigins:<name>; a datapack may define more via data/<ns>/neoorigins/entity_groups/<name>.json. Changes effect/enchant interactions and which mobs ignore, hunt, or flee you. undefined = no classification.

morph.description: Named morph definition to use, e.g. neoorigins:sheep. A bare name resolves in the neoorigins namespace. Built-ins: slime, magma_cube, sheep, cat, villager, creeper, zombie, skeleton, enderman, spider — a datapack file at data/<ns>/neoorigins/morphs/<name>.json overrides one or adds your own. Any field set alongside this overrides the definition's value.

entity_type.description: Entity id whose model replaces the player's, e.g. minecraft:slime. Overrides the referenced morph's entity type. It also supplies the morph's voice and, unless hitbox is false, its collision box.

nbt.description: Partial NBT applied to the rendered stand-in to pick a variant, e.g. {"Color": 14} for a red sheep, {"Size": 2} for a bigger slime, {"VillagerData": {"profession": "minecraft:librarian"}}. Applied once when the morph appears, not per frame. The Team key is ignored (a render stand-in has no business joining a scoreboard team).

scale.description: Uniform scale of the morph model (default 1.0). It resizes the collision box along with the model unless hitbox is false.

hitbox.description: Whether the player collides at entity_type's size instead of their own (default true). Set false for a look-only morph. Eye height follows the hitbox, so a small morph sees from lower down, and size_scaling still applies on top. A morph that would grow the player into blocks waits until there's room rather than pushing them through, so it can be applied in a tight space and simply won't take until they step clear.

render_held_item.description: Whether the player's held items are drawn on the morph, so others can see what they're carrying (default true). A morph with hands holds the item; one without floats it in front of the body instead.

render_armor.description: Whether the player's worn armour is drawn on the morph (default true). Only takes effect on morphs whose entity renders armour at all — zombies, skeletons and piglins do; sheep, slimes and villagers do not.

first_person.description: What the morphed player sees in their own view. "item" draws the held item without the vanilla arm (default); "arm" additionally shows the morph's own arm when the hand is empty, the way vanilla shows yours; "hidden" draws nothing at all.

arm.description: Name of the bone to draw as the morph's arm in "arm" mode. Only needed when auto-detection picks the wrong one: humanoid mobs are found automatically, as are bones named right_arm / left_arm and the common variants. A name that doesn't exist on the model logs a warning and falls back to auto-detection.

skin.description: Reskin the player instead of replacing their model. Independent of entity_type — the player keeps their own body and only the textures on it change, so arms, animations and armour all still work. Each key is layered over the player's real skin, so anything left out is inherited rather than blanked.

texture.description: Body texture, as an asset id: neoorigins:morph/fox resolves to the file at assets/neoorigins/textures/morph/fox.png. Must be a 64x64 player skin, not a mob texture.

cape.description: Cape texture, addressed the same way. Left alone when unset, so a reskin doesn't silently strip a player's real cape.

elytra.description: Elytra texture, addressed the same way. When unset the cape texture is used, exactly as vanilla does.

model.description: Arm width: "slim" for three-pixel arms, "wide" for four. Unset keeps the player's own, which is what a texture-only reskin usually wants.

entity_sounds.description: Whether the player borrows the voice of entity_type — its hurt, death, fall and swim sounds (default true). Set false to look like the mob but still sound like yourself. Step sounds always come from the block underfoot, so they never change.

sounds.description: Explicit sound overrides, layered over the voice entity_type already supplies. Use this for a morph with no entity_type (a skin morph), for a custom pack sound, or to silence one sound a mob would otherwise make. Each value is a sound event id, not a file.

hurt.description: Played when the player takes damage, e.g. minecraft:entity.fox.hurt.

death.description: Played once when the player dies.

fall_small.description: Landing from a short fall (four blocks or less).

fall_big.description: Landing from a long fall. Set independently of fall_small — a morph can change only one.

splash_high_speed.description: The faster splash used when hitting water hard.

name.description: Named UUID set this power declares the player a member of; namespace it (e.g. 'mypack:kill_streak') to avoid collisions. Read/mutated by the in_set / add_to_set / remove_from_set verbs.

sources.description: Exhaustion sources to suppress, e.g. sprint, mining (default [sprint]).

size.description: Slot count, rounded to a multiple of 9 (min 9, max 54; default 9).

drop_on_death.description: If true the extra inventory drops on death instead of persisting (default false).

title.description: Optional literal title shown on the container screen when the inventory is opened. Blank/absent (default) uses the translatable 'container.neoorigins.extra_inventory'. Plain text, not a JSON text component.

fluids.description: Array form of `fluid`, for authors who prefer the plural key. Both keys are read and their entries merged.

render_armor.description: When true (default) the player turns invisible but worn armor stays visible (vanilla behaviour). When false, worn armor is also hidden client-side for true invisibility. entity_tag.description: Target every entity type in an entity-type tag (e.g. 'minecraft:skeletons').

entity_types.description: Target an explicit list of entity-type ids.

item.description: Item id to drop. An entry whose item is missing or unknown is skipped with a load-time warning.

count.description: How many to drop; clamped to at least 1 (default 1).

multiplier.description: Scalar on knockback taken: below 1 for a heavier build, above 1 to be thrown further, 0 for immunity; default 1.0 (vanilla).

strength.description: Lava fog distance multiplier; higher sees farther in lava (default 3.0). Ignored for whichever plane sets start or end.

start.description: Absolute fog start in blocks; overrides strength for the near plane (Origins 's').

end.description: Absolute fog end in blocks, i.e. how far you see through lava; overrides strength for the far plane (Origins 'v').

item_type.description: Item being used that gets reduced slowdown: any, bow, shield, or an id substring.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement-speed bonus while using the item, as a fraction of base (default 0.5).

max_light_level.description: Highest light level at which the effect still applies (default 4).

effect.description: Mob effect id applied at/below the light threshold (required).

ambient.description: Whether the applied effect is ambient (fainter particles; default true).

show_particles.description: Whether the effect's ambient particles are shown (default false).

show_icon.description: Whether the effect's HUD icon is shown (default false).

duration_multiplier.description: Scalar on the duration of potion effects the player drinks; default 1.0 (vanilla).

bonus_rolls.description: Extra rolls added to `rolls` per activation; default 0. Mirrors vanilla loot-pool naming.

threshold.description: Health fraction below which the effects activate (0.5 = 50%; default 0.5).

aggression.description: neutral = vanilla AI unchanged (only retaliate applies); hostile = always target the target type on sight; conditional = target a player only while every hostile_when condition holds. Default neutral.

hostile_when.description: List of conditions (AND-ed) tested against the PROSPECTIVE PLAYER TARGET (piglin-style, e.g. 'player not wearing gold'), not the mob. Only used when aggression = conditional; empty list behaves like hostile.

retaliate.description: Also fight back against whatever damaged the mob (vanilla hurt-by-target). Default true.

anger_linger_ticks.description: Keep the target this many ticks after the trigger stops holding, so the mob calms down gradually instead of instantly (default 200 = 10s).

aggro_range.description: Max distance to acquire a target (default 16.0).

target_type.description: Entity type id to be hostile toward; omitted = players. Conditions only apply to player targets.

call_for_help.description: When retaliating, alert nearby same-type mobs (vanilla pack aggro). Default false.

passive.description: When true, the ignore is unconditional — even hitting the mob does not provoke retaliation. Default false (the mob may target back briefly after being hit).

green.description: Green channel of the player model tint, 0.0 to 1.0 (default 1.0).

food_tag.description: Optional item tag; only matching foods are overridden.

location.description: Nested LocationCondition object resolving the respawn target (its own dimension/biome/biome_tag/biomes/structure/structure_tag/etc. fields). Required — the power has no respawn target without it.

dimension.description: Dimension the player must be in, e.g. minecraft:the_nether (combines with AND).

biome.description: Exact biome id to match, e.g. minecraft:desert (biome fields OR-combine).

biome_tag.description: Biome tag the current biome must be in, e.g. minecraft:is_forest (OR-combines with biome/biomes).

biomes.description: List of biome ids; matching any one satisfies the biome requirement (OR-combines with biome/biome_tag).

structure.description: Exact structure id the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village_plains (combines with AND).

structure_tag.description: Structure tag the position must be inside, e.g. minecraft:village (combines with AND).

allow_water_surface.description: When resolving a spawn, allow standing on the water surface (default false).

max_y.description: Maximum Y for the spawn/location search band (optional).

can_see_sky.description: Require open sky (true) or allow caves/underground (false). Default: true on overworld-like dimensions, false in ceiling dimensions like the Nether.

pose.description: Which pose to hold the player in. 'swimming' is the prone crawl (a 0.6x0.6 body, eye at 0.4) used for crawling under a one-block gap; 'crouching' is sneak height; 'standing' pins the player upright and stops them crouching or crawling at all. A forced crouch or land crawl walks at sneak pace (vanilla's slow-movement test reads the pose), but does not set the sneak flag, so there is no ledge-stop; a forced 'swimming' out of water is a crawl only and grants no swim propulsion. The pose is NOT clearance-checked, so it fits wherever its box fits, including gaps the player could not otherwise enter; balancing that is the pack's job. Releasing it hands the player back to vanilla, which does check clearance.

toggleable.description: When true the power binds a keybind that flips the pose on/off; off releases the player to their normal pose (default true).

default_off.description: Toggleable powers only: when true the pose STARTS released so the player must opt in via the keybind (default false).

action.description: Required. The action this power blocks: fall_damage, fire, drown, freeze, sprint_food, armor_equip (per-slot via head/chest/legs/feet), chestplate_equip (legacy alias = armor_equip chest), eye_damage, water_damage, swim, sleep, elytra, or none. Case-insensitive, so the SCREAMING_CASE spelling is equally valid; lowercase is canonical and is what the mod writes back out. A value outside this list silently falls back to none, which disables the power, so the editors reject it rather than let it through.

active_when.description: Player-state gate the prevention applies under: always, not_sneaking, sneaking, not_on_ground, or on_ground (default always). E.g. not_sneaking lets a crouching Avian still take fall damage. Case-insensitive, with lowercase canonical. A value outside this list silently falls back to always, so the editors reject it rather than let it through.

head.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the helmet slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

chest.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the chestplate slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

legs.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the leggings slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

feet.description: ARMOR_EQUIP only: when true, block equipping items in the boots slot. Ignored for other actions (default false).

damage_types.description: Comma-separated damage-type filter (msgIds, registry keys, or #tags); only matching killing blows are prevented. Omit to prevent every lethal hit.

invert.description: When true treat damage_types as a blacklist: prevent all deaths EXCEPT the listed types. Meaningless (ignored) without damage_types. Default false.

set_health.description: Health the player is left at after a save; clamped to at least 1 so they don't re-die next tick (default 1.0).

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks the power goes inert after a save (20 = 1s); default 0 = no cooldown (Origins behaviour, every lethal hit saved).

entity_action.description: Optional EntityAction run on the player each time a lethal hit is prevented (defaults to noop).

condition.description: Optional EntityCondition gating the save: the power only prevents death while it passes (default always-true).

entity_condition.description: Condition evaluated against each nearby LIVING entity: every one that satisfies it becomes invisible to the holder. Only living entities are candidates, so boats, minecarts, item frames, dropped items and projectiles are never hidden. Omit it to hide every living entity. An array is read as its members AND-combined. Because it is tested against an arbitrary entity rather than the holder, only entity-general verbs apply — entity_type, in_tag, target_group, living, on_fire, health, relative_health, status_effect/has_effect, nbt, constant, and and/or/not over those. A condition using any other verb still loads, but warns and hides nothing rather than hiding everything.

items.description: Item ids or #tags spared from durability loss; empty list (default) protects every damageable item the holder uses.

projectile_types.description: Projectiles blocked: arrow, fireball, trident, all, or an entity id (default arrow).

chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 an incoming matching projectile is negated (default 1.0).

teleport.description: If true a successful dodge triggers a short random teleport (default false).

teleport_range.description: Max teleport distance in blocks on a dodge when enabled (default 16).

bonus_mining_speed.description: Fraction of base mining speed added to crafted tools (default 0.25).

bonus_attack_damage.description: Fraction of base attack damage added to crafted weapons (default 0.20).

bonus_armor_toughness.description: Flat armor toughness added to crafted/smithed armor (default 1.0).

durability_multiplier.description: Fraction of base durability added to crafted items (default 0.10).

intercept_menus.description: Menu-type ids whose result slot also grants the quality buff when the crafted item is taken (e.g. a modded smithing station). Unknown ids simply never match, so listing a menu from a mod that is absent is harmless. Empty (default) = the vanilla crafting/smithing paths only.

master_slots.description: Random master-tier villager trades added to wandering traders (default 3).

treasure_chance.description: Probability 0.0-1.0 a rare treasure trade is also offered (default 0.25).

fluid.description: Fluid the player must be in to heal: water (default) or lava.

amount_per_second.description: Health points restored once per second while submerged; default 1.0 (half a heart).

radius.description: Radius in blocks of the outward shove; default 6.

strength.description: How hard entities inside the radius are pushed away; default 1.0. Players are included.

condition.description: Optional DSL condition gating the ability; it only fires while this passes (default always).

key.description: Optional hotkey this active power binds to. A plain number N pins it to named-hotkey pool slot 'Hotkey N' (1-64); several powers sharing the same N all fire from that one key. min.description: Lower bound of the resource bar.

max.description: Upper bound of the resource bar.

start_value.description: Initial value on grant; defaults to max.

regen_rate.description: Amount added each regen interval (0 = no regen).

min_action.description: Optional EntityAction fired when the value reaches min.

max_action.description: Optional EntityAction fired when the value reaches max.

hidden.description: When true, hides the bar from the HUD (mechanics still apply).

backing.description: Optional external pool that backs this bar's value instead of the internal store. label.description: Bar label shown on the HUD.

should_render.description: When false, hides the bar (stored inverted as hidden=true).

animated.description: Animated bar-FX preset id (e.g. neoorigins:fire); empty = static bar.

tint.description: Optional hex tint multiplied over the animated preset art (e.g. #FF8800); empty = untinted.

always_render.description: When true, keeps the bar on-screen even at full value (the HUD hides full bars by default).

restrictions.description: List of slot restrictions, each {slot, item?, tag?}: when a matching item (by id and/or #tag) is equipped in that EquipmentSlot (head/chest/legs/feet/mainhand/offhand) it is ejected back to the inventory. slots.description: EquipmentSlot names the equip gate applies to: mainhand, offhand, head, chest, legs, feet, body. Empty (default) = all slots.

hands.description: InteractionHand names the use gate applies to: mainhand, offhand. Empty (default) = both hands.

prevent_equip.description: When true, equipping a matched item into a gated slot is rejected (ejected back to the inventory). Default false.

prevent_use.description: When true, USING a matched item (right-click / raise: shields, totems, bows, food, ...) in a gated hand is cancelled — including stopping a totem of undying from saving the holder. Default false.

Accepts BOTH a legacy singular shape (top-level item/count/enchantments/legacy_tag/components) and a plural shape (stacks: [ { item, count, enchantments, legacy_tag, components } ]). components.description: Singular-shape SNBT data-component patch applied to the granted item.

stacks.description: Plural shape (v2.2.0). Each entry mirrors the singular root field names. When non-empty, takes precedence over the singular item/count/enchantments/legacy_tag/components fields.

ambient.description: When true the effect renders as ambient (faint beacon-style particles); default true. Cascades onto `effects` entries that omit it.

show_particles.description: When false the effect's swirling particles are suppressed; default false. Cascades onto `effects` entries that omit it.

show_icon.description: When false the effect's HUD status icon is hidden; default true. Cascades onto `effects` entries that omit it.
